Rabies Vaccine Vials Seized in Delhi; Manufacturer Denies Involvement

Authorities in Delhi seized suspected fake rabies vaccine vials from an unlicensed premises in Mukherjee Nagar on April 22, 2026. The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) reported the seizure, which involved the Crime Branch of the Delhi Police and Drugs Inspectors. The manufacturer, the Indian Immunologicals Limited (IIL), has stated that the seized vials are not theirs and they stand by their product. The CDSCO flagged the seized vials as potentially 'fake'. The investigation is ongoing.
